generalEvidence: Page: "Bring this to the polls with you 2026 Midterm Republican Sample Ballot" and "November 3rd, 2026- Tuesday Important - Next Election-2026 Midterm Elections". Ballot image: https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/2aaa0978-37d5-4a53-b317-d604b15cda4b/20261017_223933.jpg
whyItCounts: Township Republican organization (party club) with stated stances (cut taxes, fight crime, family values).
note: List is an image ('REPUBLICAN SAMPLE BALLOT ... Paid for by Republican Organization of Orland Township'); quotes transcribed from it. The image labels Nicole La Ha 'STATE REPRESENTATIVE, 32ND DISTRICT'; she is the 82nd District nominee in the input, so office set to 82nd.

Davis (D). The 82nd mapping (already in the transcription) is sound; "32ND" is a printing error on the image.
